comment:
Concerns / changes: Summary Action: Build a community of practice around the Reference Architecture

To fill these translation gaps, the Asia eHealth Information Network, together with the Pacific Health Information Network, jointly announce the creation of the Asia-Pacific COIL (AP-COIL).

The goals of AP-COIL are:

1. Rapid, systematic, structured dissemination of the WHO-ITU Reference Architecture. AeHIN and PHIN will host webinars and feature resource persons from WHO-ITU as speakers. The regional networks will pull in the right audience in each region and country.

2. Formalizing the Asia-Pacific Community of Interoperability Labs (AP-COIL) as a community of practice aligning the global, regional, and national reference architectures. WPRO/SEARO regional experts will be invited to provide guidance and oversight.

3. Empowering the AP-COIL to craft the regional implementation guides along with a regional reference implementation on Open Health Stack (tbc). This regional effort can begin from the best practices and lessons learned from the International Patient Summary for the Hajj as a use case.

4. Committing the AP-COIL members to continuously connect their country's efforts to the regional interoperability blueprint and ensure alignment through continuous knowledge sharing.

Attached as Part 2 are the AP-COIL Concept Note (Part 2) and the proposal for a Philippine-specific reference implementation using OpenHealthStack (annex). Both are needed to show alignment of the WHO-ITU Reference Architecture for Digital Public Infrastructure with the WPRO/SEARO Regional Action Frameworks and a national digital health strategy.
